learned: 2026-10-17: Shopify page /pages/lab-testing lists ~188 report PDFs on cdn.shopify.com. Only the Live Rosin (OH-LROG-###) reports are real <a href> links; the rest (OH-A-* All-In-One vapes, OH-C-* carts, OH-G-* gummies, OH-EA-* effect AIOs, OH-S-* syrups) sit in data-pdf-url attributes on <a href="#" class="lab-test-link">, which the links source does not read.
notes: Live Rosin link text reads '#018 Blueberry Swirl “Sky Blue”': the catalog names the product by the quoted name (Sky Blue), so the quoted part is the strain.

Filenames are the lot: OH-LROG-018_PASS.pdf. Prefixes: LROG live rosin, A all-in-one, C cart, G gummies (AW Awaken, EU, IL Illuminate, LL Limelight, ME Mellow, OL Offline, SE Serenity, DD Daydream), EA effect AIO, S syrup.
Most reports sit in data-pdf-url on <a href="#" class="lab-test-link"> (link_attr); their text is the lot, so the strain comes from the report (DRS prints the product line).
